bootstrap_architecture.stage1: System updates, operator creation, explicit public-key installation, computed fingerprint challenge generation (/opt/cybrik/.operator_ssh_challenge), scoped sudoers, Docker CE installation, fail2ban, UFW baseline, DOCKER-USER chain filter, candidate SSH config, and health verification (/opt/cybrik/.bootstrap_stage1_healthy)

non_forgeable_guards: Fingerprint computed directly from /home/cybrik-admin/.ssh/authorized_keys (no caller assert)
Invocation requires active SSH session (SSH_CONNECTION / SSH_CLIENT / SSH_TTY non-empty)
Challenge nonce matching and single-use atomic consumption

bootstrap_architecture.stage2: Enforces PermitRootLogin no, PasswordAuthentication no, sshd -t syntax test, reload sshd (DENIED if Stage 1 health marker or operator proof is absent or invalid)
bootstrap_architecture.verify: Independent post-bootstrap check of OS, accounts, sudoers, sshd, Docker, fail2ban, Chrony, UFW, DOCKER-USER, and forbidden ports

operator_privilege_and_auth_model.sudo_model: SCOPED_COMMAND_ALIASES (CYBRIK_INFRA = systemctl, service, ufw, docker, apt-get, journalctl, iptables, /opt/cybrik/bin/*)

threat_model_disclosure.rationale: Docker socket access (/var/run/docker.sock) grants root-equivalent control over the host via container management. Scoped sudoers enforces operational safety and prevents accidental unprivileged misuse.

ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PreLockdownRootBaseline: Empirically proven via real SSH login (ROOT_SSH_PRE_LOCKDOWN = PASS)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PermitRootLogin: no (Applied in Stage 2 after challenge-bound operator proof)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PostLockdownRootDenial: Empirically proven via real SSH connection attempt with identical key (ROOT_SSH_POST_LOCKDOWN = DENIED)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.lockout_guard: Syntax test sshd -t executed before reload; automated rollback on failure

userns-remap.justification: User namespace remapping conflicts with PostgreSQL 16 and Valkey 8 persistent volume UID/GID ownership.

docker_user_chain_protection.bypass_test: Tested with real multi-port TCP server listening on 5432, 6379, 8000, 8600, 9000; pre-block reachability and post-block drop empirically verified via external network namespace

failure_injection_coverage.F7: Transactional Docker daemon JSON failure injection
failure_injection_coverage.F9: Operator proof adversarial invocations (root direct, non-SSH sudo, wrong nonce)
